Subject: Greenwave onboarding — PO required?

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. We (Greenwave Labs) are preparing for a short pilot with Redwood next month and want to confirm the onboarding flow. Our procurement team usually requires a PO before any invoice is paid, but for a small pilot (estimated spend $3-6k/month) the PO process will add 2–3 weeks — which would push the start date.

Is there an option to be set up on invoice-only (monthly) for the pilot with a temporary exception to the PO mandate? If so, what approvals or forms do you need from our side? Attaching our completed vendor onboarding form.

Attachments:
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)

Cheers,
Anna Morales

anna.morales@greenwave.com

Subject: Re: Greenwave onboarding — PO required?

Hi Anna — thanks for the submission and the clear context. We can sometimes allow a temporary invoice-only path for short pilots, but it needs a limited set of approvals and documentation on file. To move quickly, could you send:

- W-9 (or local tax form) and remittance contact
- A copy of the signed onboarding packet (we received the form but need signature)
- Expected monthly invoice cadence and max monthly cap you expect for the pilot

Internal note: looping in Priyom and David from Procurement for the approval ladder. Marissa from CS so she can track billing expectations with the customer.

If you can provide the signed packet and W-9 today, I can start an expedited approval request.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Thanks Olga — quick procurement guidance so we can align:

- We can approve a temporary "invoice-only" onboarding for pilots up to $10,000/month provided:
  - Customer W-9 and signed onboarding packet are on file
  - Procurement approves exception and Finance sets special AP routing code
  - Term limited to 3 months (renewal requires PO or new approval)

- Approval ladder for exceptions:
  1) Onboarding lead (Olga) sign-off (operational fit)
  2) Procurement manager (Priyom) approves exception (policy deviation)
  3) Finance (David) configures AP code and confirms billing route

I'll prep the exception request form and the shared Drive checklist. Olga — if you approve operationally, I will route to Finance for the final AP code setup.

Link to checklist: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Onboarding/Greenwave_Onboarding_Checklist

— Priyom

Small legal note from my side: if we go invoice-only, add a short clause to the onboarding packet that states "This temporary invoice-only arrangement is limited to the pilot period and does not constitute waiver of future PO requirements." Also ask the customer to confirm they will accept standard T&Cs and that invoices will reference the contract id when a PO is issued later. That will keep paper trail tidy for transitions.

I can draft the short addendum; let me know and I will include in the exception packet.

— Karthik

Subject: Re: Greenwave onboarding — PO exception approved (conditions)

Anna — good news. Procurement and Finance have approved a temporary invoice-only exception for Greenwave Labs under the following conditions:

1) Term: up to 3 months from first invoice (pilot window), max $10,000/month cap
2) Docs: signed onboarding packet and W-9 must remain on file (received)
3) Billing: one invoice monthly, invoices must reference Redwood contract id GH-3245 when PO is later issued
4) AP routing: Finance will set a special AP code (AP-GWL-2026) — do not change remit instructions without notice
5) Legal addendum: short temporary exception clause will be appended to the onboarding packet and countersigned electronically

I attached the approved exception form and the onboarding checklist for your records. Priyom / David — please confirm when AP code is set so Marissa can finalize the customer kickoff.

Attachments:
- approved_exception_form.pdf (PDF)
- Greenwave_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the pilot kickoff next week.
